snippet.title: Ice Cream Together | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Hyper Vyper is excited to announce Ice Cream Together: A Cozy Parlor Simulator.
Build your dream ice cream parlor with friends online by making different ice cream flavors, serving customers, and managing your stock. Cozy vibes, a multitude of customization options, and 4-player online co-op!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445110/Ice_Cream_Together_A_Cozy_Parlor_Simulator/ 
Join our community: https://discord.gg/BdP6teuyNE
